title: ADR-0162 revision: write a closing outcome only when the approval is over, and hold the document for the whole approval (item 8 rulings)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed · Source: the two maintainer rulings on the #37767 design note (2026-11-27)

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：把维护者对第 8 项设计说明的两条裁定写进 ADR-0162：多步审批全部走完才把关闭值写到单据上；声明了关闭状态的对象，审批期间从提交到结束一直锁住。约十处表述要改。
- 用户会看到什么：这张卡本身只改设计文档；改完之后的建设卡会让单据不再出现「没走完的已批准」。
- 不做会怎样：第 8 项的建设卡和「声明与执行」那张卡都按旧表述写测试，开不了工，新能力发布不了。
- 顺序：先于 #37767 的建设；是一次独立的 Tier H 修订。

## What happens

ADR-0162 D5, as merged in 972114df, has the approval status mirror write each request's outcome as it is decided. On a field the object closes on, that closes the record in the middle of a multi-step approval, and the three cases of #37767 can each leave it closed on an unfinished approval.

The design note for #37767 (revision 2, posted on that card) recommends shape P and a hold through the passage. The maintainer ruled both on 2026-11-27:

- 「全部走完才显示已批准」: on a field the object closes on, a closing outcome is written only when the approval is over for that record (shape P).
- 「随新能力一起全程锁」: on an object that declares `closedStates`, the document is held from submission to the end of the approval, and the hold ships with the key.

## Expected

One revision of `docs/adr/0162-*.md`, of its own, before the build. Section 5 of the design note lists the statements it touches:

- **D5.** "The mirror writes each request's outcome as it is decided"; the second of the "four situations only"; "Two passes of the pending lock do not carry over", for a node after the last step; the reasons for conditions 5 and 6; the premise of the first three bullets of "What the conditions do not reach"; "Approved again ... the field holds `pending` once more".
- **Consequences.** The steps after an approval decision as refused writers; the record open again while the next step is pending; two bullets under the cost.
- **Alternatives.** "Hold a step's outcome back until the approval is over" moves to chosen for closing fields; the narrow form of "Set the object's validation rules aside" is decided against; the narrower timing of P stays "considered, not taken", with the note's paragraph on why.
- **Execution.** Item 7's "Between two steps is after one step's closed outcome", and item 8 restated for shape P, the hold, the reconciler and the host refusal.
- **Conditions.** Condition 5 is dropped or restated, and condition 6 kept with its reason restated; the revision gives its choice and why.
- **The seat's rulings on the note**, which the revision records where the ADR speaks to them: a host with no `job` service refuses an approval on a closing field at its first request; a request records the run that carries its record (item 7 slice A); the set of between-two-steps stops is stamped when the approval opens (item 7 slice B); a failure the flow routes to an end without asking the next step counts as unfinished (N46, option c′).

No statement in the words of an earlier maintainer ruling changes.

## Done when

- [ ] One PR revises ADR-0162 as above, Tier H, and lands through os-zhuang.
- [ ] Every statement the design note's section 5 names is revised or kept with a reason in the PR body.
- [ ] The status line stays `Proposed` (README "Status hygiene").
- [ ] The two rulings above are quoted with their dates.
